title: Safety-gated upstream source archive comparison
summary: Reject unsafe ZIP archives before content hashing, then report file-level added/removed/changed/unchanged entries and both complete archive SHA-256 values.
invariants: Run archive structural/size/ratio checks BEFORE integrity streaming or comparison.
Never extract or execute archive contents as part of comparison.
An archive member changed/unchanged classification is not proof of API, ABI or runtime compatibility.
If either source archive is unavailable the result is NOT_RUN, never an empty diff.
procedure: Acquire the historical 2015 release and newer 2026 candidate, record provenance/license.
Run python3 tools/compare_upstream.py historical.zip candidate.zip --out comparison.json.
Review executable, source and installer deltas; follow with the static API diff and native runtime qualification.
